verbalization: The visible evidence suggests a potential relationship between the compound (3S,5S,8S,9S,10S,11R,13S,14S,16S)-10,13-dimethyl-2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,11,12,14,15,16,17-tetradecahydro-1H-cyclopenta[a]phenanthrene-3,11,16-triol and the BT-474 cell line. The inhibition of this enzyme by NU1025 may disrupt the normal function of the BT-474 cells, potentially leading to cell death or other adverse effects. The evidence suggests a mechanistic link between the compound and BT-474, though further validation is needed to confirm the drug's specific mode of action and its relevance to the disease.
